Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Maria Luisa of Savoy’s father-in-law as Louis XIV of France by assuming Philip V’s father was Louis XIV. In reality, Philip V’s father was Louis, Grand Dauphin (son of Louis XIV). This genealogical misidentification propagated through subsequent steps, driving the search toward confirming an incorrect relationship instead of verifying the correct father-in-law.
